metadata.methodology: Serial CLI sessions over pipes; parent monotonic wall clock. Startup: spawn to complete first board, 3 discarded launches per target, rotated target order. Idle RSS: ps after first board (first 5 measured launches). Search: first hint in fresh session, then repeated hints in that session with cleared engine search table; first repeat discarded except L10. L10: first search plus 2 repeats. Peak RSS: macOS /usr/bin/time -l across each entire search session. These are warm-filesystem process starts, not cold boot starts. All search result frames must match across runtimes and repeats. Local move: play e2e4 from a reset board, including validation and render, 3 discarded then 25 measured. No console output inside timed regions.
